end.summary:
Practised making one mark for each object to keep track without number names.
Matched marks back to objects to identify missing or extra objects.
Explained a one-mark-per-boat method for checking boats returning.
Initially made some marks without linking each mark to one object; corrected this later.
Spread-out rows still seemed to have more objects; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised one-to-one matching with marks, objects, boats, bags, plates, and bangles. Parth corrected the marking mix-up by linking one mark to each object and explained the boat-and-stone method. They still mixed up whether spreading objects changes the quantity at the end. At home, place a few objects in two rows—close together and spread out—and match them one by one to check that the amount stays the same.
